title: Lahu Lahu Hai
body:
Hussain Hussain
Karbala Karbala (2)
Karbobala Me Sheh Ka Lashkar Lahu Lahu Hai
Daste Bala La Sara Manzar Lahu Lahu Hai.
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Aada Me Ghir Gye Hain Zaynab Ke Shaahzade
Mehve Fuga Zami Hai Ambar Lahu Lahu Hai
2 .Ghodo Ne Jisme Qasim Pamaal Kar Diya Hai
13 Baras Ka Ibne Shabbar Lahu Lahu Hai
3 .Shaahe Hoda Ki Khatir Katwa Ke Apne Bazu
Dariya Kanaare Shere Haider Lahu Lahu Hai
4 . Umme Rabaab Ko Ab Sheh Kya Jawaab Denge
Gardan Pe Teer Kha Kar Asgar Lahu Lahu Hai
5 . Aidi Ragad Rahi Hai Shabbir Ki Kamaai
Seene Pe Naiza Kha Kar Akbar Lahu Lahu Hai
6 .Zahra(S.A)Ki God Me Hai Shabbir Ka Kata Sar
Maqtal Me Zalzala Hai Sarwar Lahu Lahu Hai
7 .Maara Kisi Ne Paththar Bunde Kisi Ne Chine
Gazi Kaha Hai Binte Sarwar Lahu Lahu Hai
8 .Touke Gira Gale Me Hatho Me Hath Kadi Hai
Paao Me Aable Hain Laagar Lahu Lahu Hai
9 .Rizwan Ka Ye Nouha Farhaan Ki Zaba Se
Chashme Imame Aakhir Sun Kar Lahu Lahu Hai
